A1.justification: Both PDFs describe FAML, and all supplied pages, equations, tables, and figures are readable and comparable. However, both reference a Technical Appendix that neither PDF contains, preventing comparison of that supplementary material.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification and calibration results, component ablations, uncertainty visualizations, and parameter sensitivity experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains original experiments and analyses, adds ETMC comparison results, and revises several reported scores.

M1.justification: The documented FAML procedure and Equations 2–14 are unchanged: adaptive priors, fairness regularization, confidence-weighted fusion, opinion alignment, and the class-balanced objective remain identical. The new theoretical analysis does not modify the algorithm.

E1.justification: Both evaluate Handwritten, Animal, Scene15, YaleB, and Caltech-101, and both already include the BRCA illustration. Although the abstract changes the dataset count from five to six, no additional dataset or test scenario appears in the supplied material.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds ETMC as a separate comparator on all five benchmarks while retaining TLC, I-EDL, R-EDL, TMC, CCML, and ECML. ETMC is reported numerically but is not explained in the comparator descriptions.

E3.justification: The stated protocol retains the 20% test allocation, class-balanced testing, Pareto-sampled imbalanced training, head/medium/tail reporting, ACC and ECE metrics, and 200 training epochs. No protocol revision is documented to explain the changed scores.

E4.justification: Table 2 retains the same five component combinations and scores. The Animal uncertainty analysis, Handwritten evidence-strength visualization, and gamma sensitivity analysis in Figures 3–5 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report means and standard deviations over five runs, with Table 1 specifying five random seeds. Changed numerical means and deviations do not introduce a new uncertainty-reporting practice.

E6.justification: Table 1 adds five ETMC rows and revises nine retained method/dataset rows. For example, FAML's Caltech-101 ACC changes from 87.1 ± 0.9 to 83.6 ± 1.0; its YaleB ACC changes from 90.4 ± 0.7 to 88.3 ± 2.9 and ECE from 16.3 ± 3.4 to 10.9 ± 3.4. TMC's YaleB ACC changes from 68.0 ± 3.6 to 80.0 ± 0.6. These substantially revise the comparative results despite unchanged stated settings.

T1.justification: v1's propositions about convergence to a uniform prior and modification of subjective-logic base rates are replaced. v2 introduces an evidence-margin definition, a margin generalization lemma, and Theorem 3 claiming minority-class margin increases and tighter generalization bounds. This substantially changes the theoretical foundation; proofs are not supplied.

C1.justification: The abstract adds an explicit claim that theoretical analysis establishes enhanced fairness and changes the experimental scope claim from five datasets to six. The central methodological contributions and conclusion remain otherwise unchanged.

C2.justification: The theory discussion shifts from prior/base-rate behavior and misleading confident fusion to interpreting margin improvements. v2 specifically argues that greater imbalance combined with stronger adaptive-prior feedback produces greater generalization gains. The empirical interpretations and stated applicability remain largely unchanged.

D1.justification: The available implementation disclosure remains the same: PyTorch 1.13.1, fully connected networks with ReLU, Adam with L2 regularization, and prior updates starting after 20 epochs and recurring every five epochs. No additional implementation or access information accompanies ETMC; neither PDF supplies the referenced Technical Appendix.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and bibliography retain the same works and research positioning. Neither the added ETMC rows nor the new margin analysis introduces a corresponding citation.

P1.justification: Changes are concentrated in the rewritten theory subsection, limited abstract edits, definition numbering, and the author/affiliation block. Most other prose and the overall section sequence remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 1 gains ETMC rows, revised horizontal rules, and a caption above rather than below the table. Existing figures and Table 2 shift positions as the text reflows; all five figures retain their visual content.

improvement.justification: ETMC broadens the comparisons, but v2 introduces an unresolved inconsistency: Caltech-101 full-model ACC is 83.6 ± 1.0 in Table 1 while Table 2 retains 87.1 ± 0.9; these matched in v1. The stronger generalization guarantees also lack supplied proofs. These consistency and support problems outweigh the limited comparison benefit, while the unchanged core method and analyses limit the overall decline.
